scope: Read and compare the bounded common wireframe-presence bit for inline AC1024 SAB modeler entities. This does not decode the optional wireframe body.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.finding: The common modeler layout places Wireframe data present after the ACIS carrier; a true bit is followed by wireframe and optional silhouette records.

source.fixturePolicy: The drawing already exists in libdxfrw; no new fixture was added.

independentComparison.result: The exact source yields five AC1024 3DSOLID records. All five report wireframe_data_present=1; handle 0x1da contains seven wire records.

implementation.behavior: When exact inline SAB end-marker framing is recognized on AC1018/AC1021/AC1024, the parser positions a bounded probe at the marker end and reads the next bit into DRW_ModelerGeometry::m_hasWireframe. The SAT-v1 path reads the bit after the zero-size block terminator.

validation.ctestCoverage: Imports the tracked AC1024 source; requires exactly the five peer-listed 3DSOLID handles, typed nonempty extracted SAB payloads, true wireframe-presence values, and no duplicate or unexpected 3DSOLID handles.
validation.satV1Regression: All 48 AC1018 SAT-v1 handles 0x2a through 0x59 passed the selected ASCII/Binary projection selector again, including source unit, payload equality, refusal and retry checks.

limitations: This compares one presence bit across two observed profiles; it does not qualify producer-family coverage.
When the bit is true, point, isoline, wire, silhouette, viewport and transform fields remain opaque and are not surfaced as typed data.
The result does not establish ACIS placement, geometry semantics, native consumer acceptance, whole-document output or support claims.
